0211Audio-visual techniques and media production

Inkscape computer-use environment

earakely-scale/InkscapeComputerEnv-REA

Change a bake sale poster's headline from Spring to Summer with Inkscape's text tool and save the SVG.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • GUI agent evaluation on a real desktop app
  • small file-editing computer-use task

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Pass or fail

A verify.py script reads the app's saved files through the computer's data/get view and passes only if every check holds, with no model judge.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

pip install agentenv-framework==0.9.1431
hf download earakely-scale/InkscapeComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir inkscape
agent-env run inkscape/bundle --task summer-headline --agent claude-code --model <model>

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/InkscapeComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir InkscapeComputerEnv-REA

Needs: Docker; model provider configured for agentenv.

Evidence

3 of 3 Claude Code runs passed. The verifier failed on the seed and passed after the edit.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
